When my Savior, my Shepherd is near
When my Savior, my Shepherd is near,
His presence gives peace to my soul,
And Satan assaults me in vain;
While my Shepherd his pow’r controls,
I think I no more shall complain.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Newton printed the hymn under Jeremiah 1:19. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
They will fight against you but will never overcome you, since I am with you to deliver you,” declares the LORD. JEREMIAH 1:19 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ JEREMIAH 1

When my Savior, my Shepherd is near, How quickly my sorrows depart! New beauties around me appear, New spirits enliven my heart: His presence gives peace to my soul, And Satan assaults me in vain; While my Shepherd his pow’r controls, I think I no more shall complain. STANZA I
